description: This file provides utilities for handling video streams for a number plate recognition system. It includes functions for generating MJPEG video streams with overlaid detection bounding boxes, handling camera input via OpenCV, and fallback synthetic stream generation if OpenCV or camera access is unavailable.

methods.name: _draw_detections(frame, detections)
methods.description: Overlays bounding boxes and confidence labels onto a video frame based on detection data.

methods.name: _encode_jpeg(frame)
methods.description: Encodes a video frame as JPEG, returning success status and data.

methods.name: Generator[bytes,None,None] mjpeg_generator(detector, cam_index: int = 0, width: int = 640, height: int = 480, target_fps: int = 10)
methods.description: Main generator function that yields MJPEG frames with detection overlays, handling camera access and fallback to synthetic frames if needed.

ctags.name: mjpeg_generator
ctags.pattern: /^def mjpeg_generator(detector, cam_index: int = 0, width: int = 640, height: int = 480, target_fp/
ctags.signature: (detector, cam_index: int = 0, width: int = 640, height: int = 480, target_fps: int = 10)

ctags.name: np
ctags.pattern: /^    import numpy as np  # local import for faster import time of module$/
